schema.snapshot: one observation of one market on one game, with its sampling basis and quality grade

quality_grades.verified_open: a published timestamp proves the number was taken before the close
quality_grades.verified_close: a published timestamp proves the number was taken at/after the last pregame movement
quality_grades.documented_open_undocumented_time: a separate publisher file that is clearly early (it differs from the closing value) but is not timestamped
quality_grades.unattributed_single_observation: one price, no stated sampling time; neither open nor close can be claimed

schema.invariant: A market may never have a closing snapshot without an opening snapshot of equal or better quality; where only one exists the row is published as unattributed and counted as missing_open or missing_close.

price_completeness.note: A line with no price cannot be staked and cannot be ROI-tested. Legs are counted per side, so one game contributes two spread legs.
